title: SubViewport node not found in Viewport texture
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in 4.7.stable.steam ### System information Windows 11 - Godot 4.7.stable.steam - Vulkan (Forward+) - NVIDIA RTX 4090 610.47 ### Issue description A `ViewportTexture` with an assigned `SubViewport `may throw an error on project reload, that the `SubViewport` node can no longer be found. Sometimes the error is silent, and the texture displays incorrect content. ### Steps to reproduce - Create a new project - Create a new scene - Add the following nodes: `SubViewportContainer` |- `SubViewport` |-|-`Sprite2D` - Add a new shader material to the `SubViewport` container - Create a new shader with the following contents: ``` shader_type canvas_item; uniform sampler2D screen : filter_linear; void fragment() { COLOR = texture(screen, UV).rgba; } ``` - In the resource pane, set the shader in the shader material to scene local. - Set the screen uniform to a new `ViewportTexture` with the `SubViewport` as its input. - Save the scene and duplicate it. Change the texture of the `Sprite2D` to something different, just for identification. - Reload the project. - After reload, the second scene will have a missing texture as the viewport texture, but still references the real `SubViewport` Before reload: After reload: ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [Subviewport-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29114264/Subviewport-mrp.zip)
